messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: rstan 2.14.1 released
parts:
The rstan 2.14.1 package has been released on CRAN and has binaries for Windows and Mac. Assuming you have followed

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/RStan-Getting-Started

you can update to 2.14.1 with

# note: omit the 's' in 'https' if you cannot handle https downloads
install.packages("rstan", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org/", dependencies=TRUE)

We didn't really announce rstan 2.13.1 (which had many more changes than 2.14.1) due to the consternation over the NUTS bug, but all of the major changes are listed at

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rstan/NEWS

Ben
